chunks: Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Ali ibn al-Hakam, from Qutayba al-A'sha, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him)

Regarding a man who gives an advance payment for sheep, specifying their ages to a known term. He gave the four-year-old in place of the five-year-old. He (peace be upon him) said: 'Is it not that he gave the advance payment for known ages to a known term?' I said: 'Yes.' He (peace be upon him) said: 'There is no problem.'
ai.seo_question: What is the ruling on exchanging livestock of different ages in an advance payment (salam) contract?
ai.summary: This narration from Imam al-Sadiq (AS) clarifies the flexibility in the 'salam' contract, a form of forward sale prevalent in early Islamic commerce, by confirming that substituting a specific age (four-year-old for five-year-old) does not invalidate the deal provided the essential conditions of known quantity, quality, and time are met. It highlights the Shia juristic emphasis on the substance of the agreement over rigid literalism, ensuring trade remains accessible and practical. This ruling underscores the principle that minor deviations in specific attributes are permissible as long as the core contractual obligations are fulfilled.

en.hubeali: Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Ali Bin Al Hakam, from Quteyba Al A’asha,

(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> regarding the man who submitted an advance payment regarding the years from the known sheep, to a known term. So he gave him the four year old in place of the five year old. So he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘Is it not that he submitted the advance payment regarding the known years to a known term?’ I said, ‘Yes’. He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘So there is no problem’.
en.sarwar: 6. Ahmad ibn Muhammad from has narrated from Ali ibn al-Hakam from Qutaybah al-‘A’sha’ who has said the following: “About the case of a man who makes advance payment for sheep of a certain age for an appointed time and the party gives him four years old in place of three years old, abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al- Salam, asked, ‘Is it not true that he has made advance payment for (animals of) known age and on an appointed time? I replied, ‘Yes, that is true.’ He (the Imam) said, ‘It is not unlawful.’”
